title: Vision Camera State v1
description: Plain-number camera state — never a THREE.Vector3 or THREE.Camera instance. See docs/bible/10-vision/229-camera-system.md and 239-render-state-model.md.

preset.description: The last named preset applied, or null if the camera has since been freely orbited away from any preset. Not persisted across a page reload.

position.description: [x, y, z] in scene units (mm-equivalent, post coordinate-transform). Null only if no camera has mounted yet.
